First measurement of the allec-oavg configuration at plantwaterer/allec revision e54027aa1f865bdd25724e9b3c1acb51b2bbc3c3 on this draw. Serving description: same weights as the earlier allec entry; short requests are read in several option orders and averaged. (The allec weights are plantwaterer/allec@e54027aa; no separate allec row is published on this board.) The author's own decision library is invoked through a first-party loopback HTTP shim. Choice and noul return native probabilities; score is unsupported. Each choice item is read once per option order (four reads); all forwarded prompts are counted in the processed tokens and in cost. Averaging is native inference, with no extra host ensemble, generated reasoning or answer repair. Text only. The native 32,768-token forward limit requires full normalized state; no raised cap or truncation. Successful public probes through 4,096 tokens establish those probes only. Of 1,500 requests, 1,120 answered and 380 returned preregistered HTTP 422 refusals for unsupported score criteria or context/state-shown limits. Refusals remain misses where their question type is supported; unsupported score questions follow the frozen scorer's supported-type rule. The scored set contains 1,125 supported-type items: the 375 unsupported score questions are excluded, while five supported-type refusals count as misses. There were no native deviations. Processed input: 739,884 expanded-prefill tokens, matching the independent offline count, with zero generated output and zero usage mismatches. The scored loop took 208.734721660614 s. Displayed self-hosted latency is an estimate under the shared method, not a measured hosted endpoint. Replay: 50 requests, 33 byte-identical, zero argmax flips and reported maximum probability difference 0.0; this does not establish byte-identical agreement on every request. Post-run health was ready. The model card declares Apache-2.0; no LICENSE file ships in the repository. The card's own training inventory lists corpora under non-commercial, copyleft or research-only terms (e.g. XNLI/translation data). Whether the Apache-2.0 declaration covers that training data is the author's claim and is unverified; commercial use should review the training-data terms. The Decision Index excludes two of its private new-domain tests for this model, reporting signs its training data overlapped them (the lab's claim, carried as such). No JevBench contamination audit was run; there is no evidence of training on JevBench items. Displayed with a non-commercial-style restriction label; this does not establish unrestricted commercial rights. The measured device was one NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 96 GB, not an established minimum. This is the completed single-row run for this configuration on this draw, with no scored retry or response repair. Usage, native-deviation, replay and health checks do not alter scored responses.
